svg.title: The washer method about the line y = −1: the region between y = √x and y = 1
svg.desc: Left: the same region between y = √x and y = 1 from x = 1 to 4, with the line y = −1 dashed below it as the axis of rotation. Arrows from the axis to the thin vertical rectangle show the outer radius R up to the curve and the inner radius r up to the line y = 1. Right: the solid made by revolving the region about y = −1, a flared horn with a wider hole, of radius 2, around the axis. The highlighted blue washer has outer radius R = √x − (−1) = √x + 1 and inner radius r = 1 − (−1) = 2. V = the integral from 1 to 4 of π[(√x + 1)² − 2²] dx = 47π/6.
svg.text: V = ∫ from 1 to 4 of π[(√x + 1)2 − 22] dx
